lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still at night, deep navy sky, azure light, orange firelight and smoke.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Megalodon.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen Megalodon-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish Megalodon-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.
